name: Harvest
one_liner: getharvest.com time-tracking app with a V2 REST API covering time, expenses, projects, clients and invoices.
auth_notes: Personal Access Token created in Harvest ID Developers section (Bearer plus Harvest-Account-Id header), or OAuth2 app registered in Harvest ID (auth code and implicit flows, refresh tokens).
access_notes: Tokens and OAuth apps are created self-serve in Harvest ID. Harvest account needed; pricing page says free trial, no credit card, and the free plan is 1 seat. No plan gating of API found on the pricing page.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve personal tokens and OAuth2 app registration, documented REST API with rate limits and pagination. No evidence of approval gating. Webhooks and sandbox not documented.

disputes.why: Auth docs show tokens and OAuth apps self-created in Harvest ID; pricing page offers free trial without credit card.
Auth page documents authorization code and implicit grant flows.
API V2 index lists a Pagination page.
Self-serve credentials, documented API, standard auth, no blocker found.

auth.quote: The API can be accessed by creating a Personal Access Token from the Developers section of Harvest ID.
We use the Authorization Code flow for server-side authorization.

access.quote: Get started on any plan with a free trial. No credit card required.
The application can be created from the Developers section of Harvest ID

api_surface.quote: The rate limit for general API requests is 100 requests per 15 seconds.

buildability.quote: Personal Access Tokens are the preferred method when you want to write your own scripts that consume our API.

identity.quote: Welcome to the Harvest API v2 Help Center
